name: mount-guardian
description: Watches shared project folders, mirrors their git metadata locally, and repairs the workspace catalog when a mapping drops.

settings.title: Auto mirror
settings.description: Mirror git metadata into the local mirror directory while a project mapping is live.

settings.title: Auto heal
settings.description: Restore git metadata from the local mirror when a mapping drops and git stops resolving.

settings.title: Extra projects (JSON)
settings.description: Optional JSON array of {"name", "path"} objects to watch in addition to discovered shared folders.
